text:
rory: Observed a spike of KMS decrypt failures from private-onprem-lon today 11:03-11:07. App errors show 403 permission_denied and consumer teams are paging. :rotating_light:
net-team-bot: alert: keystore-decrypt-failures=42 window=5m cluster=onprem-lon; top-src-pods=[svc-web-xx, svc-worker-yy]
celine: grabbing vault audit: `grep decrypt /var/log/vault/audit.log | tail -n50` -> many lines show `role=keystore-reader auth.method=token auth.token_id=tb-zzzz result=deny`
aditya: RBAC quick check: `vault policy read keystore-reader` shows legacy policy without allowed_params for `auth_method` or `source_ip`. Looks like the hardening migration didn't reach onprem-lon.
rory: weird, I thought migration ran last night. any errors in migration job?
aditya: migration job status: `kubectl -n infra get job rbac-migration-2026-03-28 -o yaml` shows `succeeded: 0` and `lastError: dial tcp 10.12.5.7:8200: i/o timeout`. So it didn't apply.
secbot: correlation: recent netpol rollout tightened egress from infra namespace on onprem-lon at 03:00; migration likely failed due to that. Recommend snapshotting audit and stopping automated restarts until resolved.
vivian: collecting artifacts now: `kubectl -n priv-keystore logs -l app=keystore-agent --since=15m` and `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault/audit.log` on control plane to ensure immediate redundancy. Uploading to secure-bucket/incidents/3891239876/ now.
celine: snippet of vault audit lines:
```
time=2026-03-28T11:04:12Z method=POST path=/v1/transit/decrypt auth.token_id=tb-zzzz role=keystore-reader auth.method=token result=deny
```
celine: token tb-zzzz issued to svcacc-worker, TTL=30d. That's a long-lived token we should avoid.
aditya: agreed. Triaging plan: 1) revoke long-lived tokens that were issued prior to migration 2) patch vault policy to require `auth_method=mfa` and `source_ip` whitelist for keystore-reader 3) replay audit to identify impacted ciphertexts 4) re-run migration after netpol canary open to vault-unseal 5) rotate keys if audit gap > 0 (compliance decision).
rory: can we do a quick canary netpol to allow egress to vault-unseal IPs from infra namespace? Need to test migration apply then revert. Keep it scoped to two nodes.
net-team-bot: suggested netpol-canary yaml:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-migration-canary
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: migration-runner
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.12.5.0/24
      ports:
      - protocol: TCP
        port: 8200
```
net-team-bot: will apply to nodes lon-canary-01/lon-canary-02 only.
vivian: while canary runs, I'm revoking tokens: `vault token-revoke tb-zzzz` and creating short-lived ops token with TTL=1h for manual decrypts.
aditya: RBAC patch we want to apply once canary confirms connectivity (Vault policy snippet):
```
path "transit/*" {
  capabilities = ["decrypt","read"]
  allowed_params = {
    "auth_method" = ["mfa"]
    "source_ip" = ["10.50.0.0/16"]
  }
}
```
aditya: we'll do canary apply to a single pod and monitor `vault_audit_lines` for denies.
ci-bot: CI gate proposed: block automated rolling restarts if `migration_heartbeat` metric < expected for >10m. Will add PR for gate.
celine: need forensic list: which ciphertexts were touched between 10:50-11:10? running `vault audit search --start 2026-03-28T10:50:00Z --end 2026-03-28T11:10:00Z | grep ciphertext` and exporting.
vivian: uploaded artifacts and partial replay to secure-bucket/incidents/3891239876/{vault-audit,replay.log}.
secbot: recommend alert change: fire if `vault_policy_mismatch` detected post-migration or if `breakglass_token_usage > 3 in 5m`. Also add metric that counts long-lived tokens issued >24h.
aditya: as immediate mitigation, besides revoking tokens, we should add a default deny for transit decrypt for the serviceaccount namespace until migration completes. That reduces blast radius.
rory: sounds good. Coordination: neteng to apply canary egress, aditya to re-run migration, vivian to handle token revocation and forensic uploads, celine to notify compliance and impacted product teams.
et-team-bot: canary applied to lon-canary-01/02; test `curl -sS https://10.12.5.7:8200/v1/sys/health` from migration-runner pod -> returns `200 unsealed`.
aditya: re-running migration job now: `kubectl -n infra create job rbac-migration-3891239876 --from=cronjob/rbac-migrator`
aditya: migration job logs: `applied policy keystore-reader -> OK` for canary pod. Monitoring audit lines for denied->allowed transitions.
celine: seeing reduced denies for canary pod; other nodes still report denies. Gradually rolling out netpol change to next nodes with 5m observation windows.
vivian: compliance asked for conservative key rotation if any decrypts failed during the window. I've opened compliance ticket CT-3891. They want list of ciphertexts & owners.
rory: assign owners: aditya=apply RBAC and rollout, net-team=canary rollout, vivian=forensics & compliance, celine=postmortem and CI gate PR. Target to close within 48h.
all: ack.
